# seerr_emby_library_sync (Resource)

Trigger and monitor full Emby library scans via `/api/v1/settings/emby/sync`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `triggers` (Map of String) Optional arbitrary map of values that will trigger a new Emby scan when changed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `progress` (Number) Current scan progress percentage or count.
- `running` (Boolean) Whether an Emby library scan is currently running.
- `total` (Number) Total items to scan.
